context: A mom and her young daughter enjoy a snow day in the yard
purpose: Teach: 連休/浴び/氷/樹/真ん中/得点/戦う/対戦

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ママ、見て!連休だから、お庭にいっぱい雪が積もったよ!
lines.en: Mom, look! Because it's a long weekend, lots of snow piled up in the yard!
lines.style: Excited young child's voice, bouncy and bright with wonder

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当だね。お日様を浴びて、雪がキラキラしてきれい。
lines.en: It really is. Bathed in the sunlight, the snow is sparkling and beautiful.
lines.style: Warm motherly tone, gentle and admiring with soft affection

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: あっ、あの樹の枝、氷でツルツルになってる!触ってみていい?
lines.en: Oh, that tree's branches have gotten all slippery with ice! Can I touch it?
lines.style: Curious child's voice, full of discovery and eagerness

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そっと触ってね。じゃあ、お庭の真ん中に大きな雪だるま作ろうか。
lines.en: Touch it gently, okay. Now, shall we build a big snowman in the middle of the yard?
lines.style: Caring maternal voice, encouraging and patient with playful warmth

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん!それからね、雪合戦しよう!ママと戦う!
lines.en: Yes! And then, let's have a snowball fight! I'll battle you, Mom!
lines.style: High-energy child voice, brimming with playful competitive excitement

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: わあ、ひなと対戦するの?ママ負けちゃうかも。
lines.en: Wow, I have to face off against Hina? Mom might just lose.
lines.style: Playful teasing mother tone, light and amused with mock worry

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ママに当たったら得点ね!私、絶対勝つよ!
lines.en: If I hit you, I get a point! I'm definitely going to win!
lines.style: Triumphant child voice, confident and full of cheeky determination

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: よーし、お母さんも本気でいくよ。覚悟してね、ひなちゃん。
lines.en: Alright, Mom's coming at you for real too. Get ready, Hina-chan.
lines.style: Loving maternal voice with playful challenge, warm and teasing
